corrections.text: The precise market figures the article attributes to Cloud Computing News -- Meta shares up 8.8%, CoreWeave down 10.8% and Nebius down 12.4% on July 1 (two of which also appear in the summary), and the projected $145 billion in AI capital expenditure this year -- rest solely on that single outlet, whose page bot-blocked (HTTP 403) and could not be archived into the provenance snapshot. Editorial review confirmed these figures accurate against the live cloudcomputing-news.net page, but no durable archived snapshot supports them; the three verifiable snapshots (Ynetnews, Fierce Network, Sherwood News) confirm the report, the leadership names, the quotes and the sector selloff, but none of them state these specific percentages or the capex figure.
